subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt five public memory role slots, per-agent role overrides, and the `memoryRole` hook option as the permanent memory composition contract?
rationale: This creates durable public config and plugin SDK surface across core, plugins, sessions, and UI; implementation correctness cannot decide the permanent taxonomy and scope.

options.title: Adopt five roles
options.body: Approve the proposed taxonomy, then require the routing repair, conflict refresh, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Land a narrower foundation
options.body: Start with a maintainer-approved subset such as recall and capture, deferring incomplete lifecycle roles or per-agent surface.

options.title: Keep the single owner
options.body: Reject the new core slot surface and require optional composition to use existing generic plugin seams.

recommendation.title: Adopt five roles
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed taxonomy, then require the routing repair, conflict refresh, and exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows the broadest ownership across plugin slots, hook runtime, memory state, dreaming, and the current UI surface.
